variants.suspected_cause: The original's constant word offsets may arise from indexing a seven-word record rather than named member access.
variants.controlled_change: Change only the five record accesses from named members to constant indices through an int pointer; retain declarations, bounds, calls, and loop.

predicted_effect.note: All indexed constants name the same 16-bit offsets as the named members, so Aztec should emit the same payload length.
